references.text: A similar situation where many Jews believe in Jesus after a miracle (the raising of Lazarus), which leads them to turn away from the religious leaders.
The religious leaders worry that 'all' will believe in Jesus and that the Romans will take away their nation, which directly connects to the verse's description that many believed.
Continuing theme of 'many' Jews coming to Jesus and believing, and that the religious leaders planned to kill Lazarus as well because of this.
Describes the reaction from the religious leaders (the Pharisees) who gather to discuss what they should do about Jesus, just as in 12:11 where the people go over to Jesus.
